easyPrerequisites: Kaya's Ghostform attached to Brotherhood Outcast.
description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Brotherhood Outcast.
When Brotherhood Outcast dies, Kaya's Ghostform triggers, returning Brotherhood Outcast from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Brotherhood Outcast enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Kaya's Ghostform from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Brotherhood Outcast.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.
